summary: Espey Mfg. & Electronics Corp. filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 announcing its board declared a special cash dividend of $0.75 per share plus a regular quarterly dividend of $0.25 per share, totaling $1.00 per share payable September 25, 2026 to holders of record September 18, 2026 on the NYSE American-traded common stock. The same release announced Kaitlyn O'Neil's promotion from Principal Financial Officer/Treasurer to Chief Financial Officer/Treasurer. No advisor, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. Watch for the ex-dividend drop and any signal of excess cash or lean balance sheet discouraging a larger special return.
